hook: Ford Motor Company left its 12-story Glass House after 70 years.

sections.voiceover: Ford Motor Company left its 12-story Glass House after 70 years.
b_roll: Exterior shot of the historic 12-story Glass House headquarters in Dearborn

sections.voiceover: In Dearborn, Michigan, the company built a $1.2 billion replacement. The 4-story structure covers a 14-acre footprint designed by Snøhetta. Why build 2.1 million square feet across just 4 floors?
b_roll: Map animation highlighting Dearborn Michigan campus site
Architectural rendering of the 14-acre building footprint designed by Snøhetta
Diagram comparing a 12-story tower layout to a low-rise 4-story layout

sections.voiceover: But the new four-story building doesn't just house 14,000 Ford Motor Company employees.
b_roll: Wide motion-graphics diagram showing capacity for 14,000 workers

sections.voiceover: Inside, a 160,000-square-foot food hall holds 7 distinct restaurants. The massive food hall spans 14,864 square meters inside the building nicknamed The Hub.
b_roll: Interior plan illustration of the 160,000-square-foot food hall
Flowchart showing horizontal department connection vs vertical division
3D graphic of the completed campus spanning 14 acres

sections.voiceover: Dearborn now hosts Ford Motor Company in 2.1 million square feet.
b_roll: Overview map graphic of Dearborn showing the 2.1 million square foot campus
